definitions.explanation: The mental faculty by which one decides on actions. Determination to do something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{意志|いし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{意志|いし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}する→尊重：03327_sonchou⟧。
{意志|いし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧。

notes:
{意志|いし} refers to a person's will, determination, or resolve — the inner drive to act or achieve something. It emphasizes firmness of purpose.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {意志|いし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: strong-willed
- {意志|いし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧: weak-willed
- {意志|いし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have a will/determination
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{意志|いし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: of one's own will
- {意志|いし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧: to carry through one's will
- {意志|いし}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧: declaration of intent

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {意志|いし} (⟦{志|こころざし}→志：06655_kokorozashi⟧): will, volition — emphasizes determination and resolve
- ⟦{意思|いし}→意思：12742_ishi⟧ (⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧): intention, mind — emphasizes what one thinks or intends
- Example: {意志|いし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (strong-willed) vs. ⟦{意思|いし}→意思：12742_ishi⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧ (expression of intent)

In practice, {意志|いし} focuses on firmness and character, while ⟦{意思|いし}→意思：12742_ishi⟧ focuses on one's wishes or intentions in a specific situation.
